# montecarlo_fivetran_credentials (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Key of the Fivetran API key. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `api_key_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `api_key_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.
- `api_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret of the Fivetran API key. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `api_password_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `api_password_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) URL of the Fivetran REST API. Leave it out for https://api.fivetran.com/v1/.

### Read-Only

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
